prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Companion Controls", "Try these quick gestures to summon, hide, and interact with your pet anytime directly from your desktop.", "Start Quick Practice", "Click tray icon to summon or hide pet", "Test Summon Gesture"]
1: ["Hatching Your Pet Companion", "Preparing desktop environment and generating pet graphics...", "Estimated completion: 45s", "Step 2 of 3: Desktop Rendering"]
2: ["Essential Pet Commands & Shortcuts", "Learn how to summon, minimize, or open chat with your desktop pet in seconds.", "Got It, Launch Pet!", "Shortcut: Alt + Pet Click"]
3: ["Choose Your Pet Experience", "Select between an interactive story adventure or a persistent desktop companion.", "Desktop Companion vs Story Adventure"]
4: ["Verify Photo Quality for Best Pet Generation", "Follow these quick steps to ensure your uploaded photo generates a clear, accurate pet model.", "Verify & Continue", "Clear face, centered lighting, single pet in frame"]
5: ["Building Your Desktop Companion", "Configuring desktop overlay physics and syncing companion graphics.", "Initializing desktop docking engine...", "Rendering pet animations..."]
6: ["Practice Desktop Pet Docking", "Try right-clicking the tray icon to see quick commands like Hide, Sleep, or Chat.", "Complete Practice", "Test Tray Command"]
7: ["Sign In to Access Your Pets", "Your saved pets and customizations automatically sync to your account upon signing in.", "Returning user? Sign in with your previous method to restore existing pets instantly.", "Automatic Account Pet Restoration Active"]
8: ["Finalizing Adoption Certificate", "Registering companion ID and generating official adoption record...", "Certificate validation in progress (10s remaining)"]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Discover whether you want a narrative story adventure or a live desktop companion that hangs out on your screen.", "Explore Paths"]
